manifest.name: reconcile_supplier_invoices_orders_bank
manifest.description: Parses supplier invoices and reconciles them against purchase orders and bank statement, reporting evidenced findings.
manifest.purpose:
a bot that reconciles our supplier invoices against the purchase orders and the bank statement: find duplicate invoices, price or quantity mismatches, invoices without an order and double payments, with the evidence (file, invoice number, amounts) for every finding

Files: folder novak_trading
manifest.headline: Checked {summary.invoices_checked} invoices and found {summary.findings} issues; the first is a {findings.0.type} on invoice {findings.0.invoice_number} ({findings.0.detail}), a difference of {findings.0.difference_czk} CZK.
examples: Are there any duplicate invoices or double payments?
Which invoices have no purchase order?
Check only price mismatches for OfficeLine
manifest.manual_basis: Open each supplier invoice PDF and key invoice number, date, lines, quantities and amounts into a spreadsheet, then match them against purchase orders and bank statement lines to flag duplicates, pric
